描述_ZN: Fan Page of Selected Plum Blossoms, painted by Xie Shichen in Ming Dynasty, on gold paper and color, 18.9 cm in length and 50 cm in width.　　The signature on the fan page reads: "Lin Bu is an immortal guest, with a rich posture of ice and jade and an embroidered chest. He chanted a shallow and oblique line, with a dark fragrance and a sparse scene. Xie Shichen's poems and paintings were made for Mr. Bihu." Inscriptions: "Si Zhong" in vermilion and "Simarouba Xian" in white.　　In the Song Dynasty, when Lin Bu was living in seclusion in the solitary mountain in Hangzhou, he was so noble and comfortable that he only took pleasure in planting plums and raising cranes, and people said that he took plums as his wife and cranes as his son. The picture depicts a peaceful Lin Bu standing on a plum tree, watching his servant trimming the branches. The figures and the trees are mainly neat and hard lines. The rocks and hills are dotted with moss, influenced by Shen Zhou's style of painting.
